page.overview:
Who is Corrin?

Corrin is the customizable avatar character in Fire Emblem Fates. Unlike Robin, however, they are also the main character of the story, having the most prominent role of an avatar character in a Fire Emblem game. The player can select Corrin's gender, physical appearance, voice, stat builds, and secondary class before playing. Corrin is notably half-dragon, being able to transform parts of their body into that of a dragon, or temporarily transform into a dragon with the power of Dragonstones. Corrin and their royal families can use Dragon Vein, a power granted from the ancestral First Dragons, which can be used to alter the user's surrounding terrain in a multitude of ways.

Corrin is a downloadable newcomer in Super Smash Bros. 4 released on February 3, 2016, alongside Bayonetta. Instead of being bundled with a new stage, like with the other DLC newcomers, two new music tracks for Coliseum and Castle Siege will be unlocked alongside Corrin.

Corrin returns alongside the series' entire playable cast in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate, this time as an unlockable character. Corrin has a unique victory theme, based upon Lost in Thoughts All Alone, the main theme of Fire Emblem Fates.
